item.text: {"cost_regression":true,"evidence":{"O1":{"citation":"“Re-evaluate all cases—A, B, and C—not just B—to detect regressions.”","status":"pass"},"O2":{"citation":"“run fresh blind evaluations 2–3 times per case, with one context-free runner per run” and “Grade each artifact separately using a fresh judge”","status":"pass"},"O3":{"citation":"“run fresh blind evaluations 2–3 times per case” and report “Each case’s post-edit pass rate.”","status":"pass"},"O4":{"citation":"Evidence is missing: the artifact does not require diagnosing a new miss as a skill defect versus a bad case, nor repeating a diagnose-revise-full-sweep loop.","status":"fail"},"O5":{"citation":"The report must include “Each case’s post-edit pass rate,” evidence-backed verdicts, confirmation that “B’s original gap is resolved,” and confirmation that “A and C still pass.”","status":"pass"},"S1":{"citation":"Smell absent: it explicitly says “all cases—A, B, and C—not just B.”","status":"pass"},"S2":{"citation":"Smell absent: it requires “one context-free runner per run” for “2–3 times per case.”","status":"pass"},"S3":{"citation":"Smell absent: artifacts are graded “using a fresh judge” separate from each runner.","status":"pass"},"S4":{"citation":"Smell absent: it requires “Each case’s post-edit pass rate.”","status":"pass"},"S5":{"citation":"Smell absent: success requires confirmation “that A and C still pass” and that the edit “caused no regressions.”","status":"pass"}},"passed":false,"rationale":"The artifact correctly requires fresh, separated, repeated full-suite evaluation and per-case evidence, but it omits the required diagnosis of whether any new miss is a skill defect or a bad case and the corresponding diagnose-revise-full-sweep loop.
